title: plugin-form: saving a master-detail grid rewrites the stored position of untouched sibling lines — the child read carries no sort by the derived sort field, and the grid stamps every row's index into it on any change
body:
Filing-gate category ① (product defect, named landing point) and ③ — the maintainer's order in the dispatching session, verbatim: 「测试遇到的问题，可以提交issue」.

QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104 · records-forms.conditional-rules-grid · A4

**Reader who acts:** the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat (`plugin-form` / `fields`). **Dedupe:** semantic issue search on this repo, closed included, "master detail grid sortField position rewritten untouched sibling rows on save no orderby invoice lines" — 8 hits, none this shape; nearest objectui#11144 (closed: it gave `inlineColumns` children their derived sort field — this defect is that field's read side).

## Environment

objectstack `36b2889c` with the console built from objectui `1fb1ced36243` (the pin hop of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104), stock `examples/app-showcase`, `--seed-admin`, admin persona. Reproduced twice on fresh loads; the defect predates the hop (no hop commit touches the implicated files).

## Reproduction

1. Fresh boot. `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice_line` filtered to invoice INV-1001 → "Consulting hours" `position: 0`, "Widget A units" `position: 1` (distinct, pristine seed).
2. Open INV-1001's edit page (`/_console/apps/showcase_app/showcase_invoice/record/ID/edit`). The grid's read is `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice_line?top=500&filter=[invoice,=,ID]` with **no orderby**, and it renders the server's order (Widget A first).
3. Change only the Consulting-hours row's Qty (`input[aria-label=Qty]`) from 10 to 11; click Save.
4. The captured `POST /api/v1/batch` carries an update for the untouched Widget A line, `{position: 0}`, beside the edited line's `{position: 1, quantity: 11, amount: 1650}`.

**Expected:** only the edited line in the batch; Widget A byte-identical. **Actual:** re-read shows Widget A `position` 1 → 0 with `updated_at` bumped, Consulting 0 → 1 — the stored order is swapped and an untouched record was written. Same on INV-1002.

## Mechanism (objectui `1fb1ced36243`)

- `plugin-form` `MasterDetailForm.tsx` `readLinesOf` → `dataSource.find(childObject, { $filter, $top: 500 })` — no sort by the child's derived sort field.
- `fields` `GridField.tsx` `emit()` stamps `row[sortField] = index` on every change, so the server's arbitrary order becomes the new stored order for every row.
